use_cases: Display customer testimonials with interactive drag-to-shuffle functionality
Showcase social proof with avatar images and quotes on product pages
Feature user reviews in a modern, glass-effect card layout
Create testimonial carousels with physics-based drag interactions
Build testimonial sections with depth and layered card positioning
ai_summary: An interactive testimonial card component with glass-morphism styling featuring dark slate colors and backdrop blur effects. The card uses framer-motion for drag interactions, allowing users to swipe and shuffle between testimonials. Features include avatar display, quote text with italic styling, and author attribution with indigo accent colors. The drag-end handler triggers shuffle animations when swiped past 150px threshold, making it ideal for testimonial carousels or review showcases in SaaS, e-commerce, or portfolio applications.
